#!/var/lang/bin/python3.12
import json, os, pathlib, urllib.request
pathlib.Path('/tmp/extension-value').write_text(@EXTENSION@)
base = 'http://' + os.environ['AWS_LAMBDA_RUNTIME_API'] + '/2020-01-01/extension'
request = urllib.request.Request(base + '/register', data=json.dumps({'events':['SHUTDOWN']}).encode(), headers={'Lambda-Extension-Name':os.path.basename(__file__), 'Content-Type':'application/json'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
    identifier = response.headers['Lambda-Extension-Identifier']
request = urllib.request.Request(base + '/event/next', headers={'Lambda-Extension-Identifier':identifier})
with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=900) as response:
    json.load(response)
